cat << 'EOF' > /workspace/test.py
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')

# 1. Revenue Gap
query_actual_rev = "SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure='Revenue' AND period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND basis='GAAP';"
query_guide_rev = "SELECT midpoint * (1 + range_width / 100.0) FROM guidance WHERE measure='Revenue' AND issue_date='2024-08-28';"
query_rev_gap = f"SELECT ({query_actual_rev[:-1]}) - ({query_guide_rev[:-1]});"
print("Revenue gap query:", query_rev_gap)
print("Revenue gap:", conn.execute(query_rev_gap).fetchone()[0])

# 2. Adjusted Gross Profit
query_gaap_gp = "SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure='Gross profit' AND basis='GAAP' AND period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3;"
query_adj_gp = "SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE measure='Gross profit' AND period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3;"
query_rebuilt_gp = f"SELECT ({query_gaap_gp[:-1]}) + ({query_adj_gp[:-1]});"
print("Rebuilt GP query:", query_rebuilt_gp)
print("Rebuilt GP:", conn.execute(query_rebuilt_gp).fetchone()[0])

# 3. Adjusted Gross Margin
query_adj_margin = f"SELECT (CAST(({query_rebuilt_gp[:-1]}) AS REAL) / ({query_actual_rev[:-1]})) * 100.0;"
print("Adj Margin query:", query_adj_margin)
print("Adj Margin:", conn.execute(query_adj_margin).fetchone()[0])

# 4. Margin Gap
query_guide_margin = "SELECT midpoint + (range_width / 100.0) FROM guidance WHERE measure='Gross margin' AND basis='non-GAAP' AND issue_date='2024-08-28';"
query_margin_gap = f"SELECT (({query_adj_margin[:-1]}) - ({query_guide_margin[:-1]})) * 100.0;"
print("Margin gap query:", query_margin_gap)
print("Margin gap:", conn.execute(query_margin_gap).fetchone()[0])

EOF
